newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Akzo invests in U.S. surfactants unit.
newsitem.headline: Akzo invests in U.S. surfactants unit.

text.p: Chemical group Akzo Nobel NV said on Thursday it would invest more than $50 million in modernising the Illinois-based surfactants plant of its U.S. subsidiary McCook.
Renovating the plant and improving the infrastructure should be completed by the end of the year 2000, the company said.
It added the investment showed its long term intention to remain active in the U.S. surfactants market and to expand its worldwide activities in this business segment.
Surfactants are used in detergents, health care products, paint, building and road construction materials.
